sources.title: Skill-LLM: Repurposing General-Purpose LLMs for Skill Extraction
sources.authors: Amirhossein Herandi, Yitao Li, Zhanlin Liu, Ximin Hu, Xiao Cai
sources.contribution: Shows that supervised LLM adaptation can improve skill extraction quality.
sources.application: Supports using a fine-tuned Mistral LoRA as the main extraction anchor.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: keep the LLM extractor as the anchor and evaluate wrappers separately.

sources.title: SkillSpan: Hard and Soft Skill Extraction from English Job Postings
sources.authors: Mike Zhang, Kristian Nørgaard Jensen, Sif Dam Sonniks, Barbara Plank
sources.contribution: Introduces expert span annotations for hard and soft skills in job postings.
sources.application: Defines the benchmark, labels, and exact boundary pressure used here.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: use test split for extraction metrics; preserve hard/soft labels.

sources.title: GLiNER: Generalist Model for Named Entity Recognition using Bidirectional Transformer
sources.authors: Urchade Zaratiana, Nadi Tomeh, Pierre Holat, Thierry Charnois
sources.contribution: Generalist NER with arbitrary labels using a compact bidirectional encoder.
sources.application: Useful as a recall booster and baseline, not a replacement for the tuned LLM.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: add-only auxiliary candidates behind non-regression gates.

sources.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
sources.authors: Tim Dettmers, Artidoro Pagnoni, Ari Holtzman, Luke Zettlemoyer
sources.contribution: Memory-efficient LoRA fine-tuning through frozen 4-bit quantized backbones.
sources.application: Justifies local Mistral adapter training on constrained GPUs.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: reuse trained adapter; do not retrain during refresh.

sources.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
sources.authors: Darren Edge, Ha Trinh, Newman Cheng, Joshua Bradley, Alex Chao, Apurva Mody, Steven Truitt, Jonathan Larson
sources.contribution: Uses graph-based structure for corpus-level reasoning beyond naive chunk retrieval.
sources.application: Supports downstream graph reasoning after extraction and normalization.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: keep graph reasoning out of the extraction gate.

sources.title: Contextual Retrieval in AI Systems
sources.contribution: Adds document context to chunks to improve retrieval reliability.
sources.application: Supports contextualized job/course retrieval with evidence.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: add deterministic contextual retrieval helper; dense/reranker later.

sources.title: Don't Do RAG: When Cache-Augmented Generation is All You Need for Knowledge Tasks
sources.contribution: Frames cache-augmented generation as useful when stable knowledge fits in context.
sources.application: Use CAG for stable profile/taxonomy/course summaries, not for changing job feeds.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: add cached context packet; keep job postings in RAG.
sources.note: Author metadata should be verified before final submission.

sources.title: Versioning Data and Models
sources.contribution: Documents Git-compatible practices for data/model artifact versioning.
sources.application: Motivates artifact manifests, stale checks, and metrics provenance.
sources.implementation_effect: Current: refresh manifest, provenance report, and artifact path tables.
